vscasino.rules.blackjack.goal.title: The Goal
vscasino.rules.blackjack.goal.text:
Beat the dealer by getting closer to 21 than they do, without going over.

Go over and you bust: you lose at once, even if the dealer busts later.
vscasino.rules.blackjack.values.title: Card Values
vscasino.rules.blackjack.values.text:
Number cards are worth their number.

J, Q and K are 10.

An Ace is 11, or 1 if that would bust you.
vscasino.rules.blackjack.playing.title: Playing
vscasino.rules.blackjack.playing.text:
Set a bet, press Deal.

You get two cards, dealer shows one.

Hit takes a card.
Stand ends your turn.
vscasino.rules.blackjack.double.title: Double Down
vscasino.rules.blackjack.double.text:
On your first two cards you may Double Down.

It doubles your bet, gives you exactly one more card, then ends the hand.
vscasino.rules.blackjack.split.title: Split
vscasino.rules.blackjack.split.text:
Two cards of the same value can be Split into two hands.

The new hand costs a second bet. You play each one in turn.
vscasino.rules.blackjack.split2.title: Split (cont.)
vscasino.rules.blackjack.split2.text:
Split Aces get one card each and stop there.

A 21 made after splitting counts as a normal 21, not a blackjack.
vscasino.rules.blackjack.dealer.title: The Dealer
vscasino.rules.blackjack.dealer.text:
Once you are done the dealer reveals their card and draws until they reach %d, then stops.

If they bust, you win.
vscasino.rules.blackjack.payouts.title: Payouts
vscasino.rules.blackjack.payouts.text:
Win: double your bet back.

Push (a tie): bet returned.

Blackjack on the first two cards pays an extra %d%%.
vscasino.rules.slots.goal.title: The Goal
vscasino.rules.slots.goal.text:
Set a bet and pull the lever.

Three reels spin and stop on a symbol each. Matching symbols pay.
vscasino.rules.slots.matches.title: What Pays
vscasino.rules.slots.matches.text:
Three matching symbols: the big payout.

Two matching: a small payout.

No match: you lose the bet.
vscasino.rules.slots.symbols.title: The Symbols
vscasino.rules.slots.symbols.text:
Most common first:

Coal
Wheat
Iron
Gold
Emerald
Diamond
vscasino.rules.slots.symbols2.title: Symbol Values
vscasino.rules.slots.symbols2.text:
The rarer a symbol, the more a match of it pays.

Three Diamonds is the jackpot.
vscasino.rules.slots.odds.title: The Odds
vscasino.rules.slots.odds.text:
This machine pays back about %d%% of all it takes, over time.

Every spin is independent. A loss does not make a win due.
vscasino.rules.poker.goal.title: The Goal
vscasino.rules.poker.goal.text:
You play alone, not against anyone.

You build one five card hand, and get paid if it is good enough.
vscasino.rules.poker.round.title: A Round
vscasino.rules.poker.round.text:
1. Set a bet, press Deal.
2. You get five cards.
3. Click cards to keep.
4. Press Draw.
5. The final hand pays.
vscasino.rules.poker.holding.title: Holding Cards
vscasino.rules.poker.holding.text:
Clicking a card switches it between HELD and Discard.

HELD cards stay. The rest are replaced when you press Draw.
vscasino.rules.poker.pay1.title: Payouts
vscasino.rules.poker.pay1.text:
You need a pair of Jacks or better. A low pair pays nothing.

Jacks+: %dx
Two Pair: %dx
Three of a Kind: %dx
vscasino.rules.poker.pay2.title: Payouts (cont.)
vscasino.rules.poker.pay2.text:
Straight: %dx
Flush: %dx
Full House: %dx
Four of a Kind: %dx
Straight Flush: %dx
Royal Flush: %dx
vscasino.rules.poker.hands1.title: Hand Types
vscasino.rules.poker.hands1.text:
Pair: two of the same rank.

Two Pair: two different pairs.

Three or Four of a Kind: three or four of a rank.
vscasino.rules.poker.hands2.title: Hand Types
vscasino.rules.poker.hands2.text:
Full House: three of a kind plus a pair.

Straight: five ranks in a row, any suits. A-2-3-4-5 counts.
vscasino.rules.poker.hands3.title: Hand Types
vscasino.rules.poker.hands3.text:
Flush: five cards of one suit.

Straight Flush: both at once.

Royal Flush: 10-J-Q-K-A in one suit.
vscasino.rules.poker.tip.title: A Tip
vscasino.rules.poker.tip.text:
Four cards to a flush or straight is usually worth chasing.

With nothing at all, discarding all five is normal.
